title: HireVeda
description:
**What You Will Do**
**Talent Acquisition**
* Own end\-to\-end hiring for tech, AI, product, and leadership roles \- sourcing strategy, JD design, pipeline management, and offer closure
* Build and manage high\-quality hiring pipelines for hard\-to\-fill roles in a competitive talent market
* Set and track hiring metrics \- time to fill, quality of hire, funnel conversion, offer acceptance rates
* Introduce AI and automation into hiring workflows to improve speed and candidate experience
* Serve as a talent partner to engineering and product leadership \- not just a hiring executor


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Own the full HR operations stack, onboarding, performance management, compensation cycles, exit processes
* Ensure HR compliance across domestic and international entities, employment law, statutory requirements, overseas HR obligations
* Design and manage compensation and benefits structures that are competitive for a product\-first organisation
* Lead payroll coordination and ensure HR systems are fit for scale


**Organisation Design \& Culture**
* Partner with the CEO on org structure decisions, reporting lines, spans of control, team design
* Build a culture of performance and ownership, not just process compliance
* Drive employee engagement and retention programmes, with a focus on engineering and product talent
* Lead leadership development and succession planning for senior roles


**HR Strategy**
* Define the people strategy for the next 2–3 years in alignment with business growth plans
* Build an HR function that scales, the right team, the right tools, the right processes
* Be a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team on all people\-related decisions


**Non\-negotiable Requirements**
**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
* MBA with HR specialisation from a Tier 1\-2 B\-school
* 20 years of progressive HR experience;
* Background in product\-based technology organisations, IT services experience alone will not be considered
* Prior experience in companies with 1000\+ employees at minimum
* Full\-function ownership, must have led both talent acquisition and HR operations, not TA alone
* Personally owned tech and AI/product hiring, not just managed a team that did it
* Willingness to be based in Kochi, this is an onsite role and location is non\-negotiable


**What We're Really Hiring For**
 We are looking for a senior leader who still builds, who brings energy and curiosity to the role, who has introduced new ways of working in the last 12 \- 18 months, and who is excited by the scope of what this role offers rather than intimidated by it.
   

  

 The best fit for this role is someone who has come through a strong product organisation and still has the drive and initiative of someone in their growth years.
   

  

**Good To Have**
* Experience managing HR for overseas entities or geographically distributed teams
* Exposure to AI/ML talent hiring or AI\-augmented HR workflows
* Background in B2B product companies (SaaS, enterprise software, maritime tech, logistics tech, fintech)
* Prior experience with international HR compliance, employment laws across multiple geographies


**WHY THIS ROLE**
 Direct report to CEO, you will be in every strategic conversation that touches people, not presenting to an HR committee.
   

  

 Full\-function ownership from day one, no handoffs, no matrix, no waiting for sign\-off from a global HR head.
   

  

 A product organisation that is growing, you are not maintaining a steady state; you are building for the next phase.
   

  

**LOCATION**
 Kochi, Kerala. This is an onsite role. The location is non\-negotiable. Candidates who are not based in Kochi or not open to relocating to Kochi will not be considered.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
Hire22\.ai is India’s 1st Agentic AI Job Portal for mid and senior\-level professionals, connecting candidates directly with employers through intelligent AI matching.
 



  





 Every JobCoNCT stays active for only 22 hours, apply quickly to avoid missing interview\-ready opportunities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




**Role Overview:** 




 Join our dynamic Talent Acquisition team as a Recruitment Specialist, where you will play a crucial role in sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates for both IT and Non\-IT positions. This position is vital for ensuring we attract and hire top talent across various industries, contributing to the company's growth and success.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Source candidates through platforms such as Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn, referrals, and social media.
* Perform Boolean searches to identify high\-quality candidates.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for IT and Non\-IT positions.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews to assess qualifications and cultural fit.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a seamless process.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process to maintain engagement.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for multiple open positions, ensuring timely closures.
* Post job advertisements and monitor job portal performance for effectiveness.
* Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and ATS records accurately.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and provide regular updates.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience from sourcing to onboarding.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2–6 years of experience in IT and Non\-IT recruitment.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end recruitment and candidate lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn, and other sourcing platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Boolean Search techniques.
* Proficiency in using recruitment tools and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and recruitment reporting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong negotiation and candidate relationship management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and detail\-focused.



  





**Preferred Qualifications/Good to Have:** 



* Experience hiring across multiple domains and industries.
* Knowledge of sourcing strategies for niche and lateral hiring.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced recruitment environment.
* Familiarity with recruitment analytics and hiring metrics.



  





**What Makes This Opportunity Attractive:** 



* Opportunity to recruit for diverse IT and Non\-IT roles across multiple industries.
* Collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Performance\-driven career progression.
* Competitive salary with incentives based on hiring performance.

title: Talent Procurement Purchasing Assistant GDS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title: Talent Procurement Purchasing Assistant GDS**
**The opportunity**
 The purpose of the global EY organization is to Build a better working world. The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long\-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS) is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge\-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS’s value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain.
   

  

 A key component of SCS is Global Procurement, whose purpose is to drive more significant synergies and value creation from sourcing to contract lifecycle management, deliver exceptional client experiences and build more vital collaboration to manage Technology, Talent and Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) spend categories. We forge meaningful supplier relationships and strengthen supplier resilience to help EY maximize long\-term value for its people, clients and communities.
   

  

 As a Talent Procurement Team member you will have the opportunity to work with a professional team of Procurement professionals in a global environment and work with colleagues on interesting sourcing projects in the GDS. Developing our people is key to deliver quality to our internal and external clients and is perfectly in line with our purpose of building a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to EY stakeholders by delivering pipeline projects, exceptional customer service, and measurable value through cost savings, cost avoidance, and contract value realization.
* Partner with senior stakeholders and Global Procurement colleagues to develop category strategies aligned with the overall global strategy.
* Build relationships with key EY stakeholders and provide regular updates on category insights and progress.
* Promote and facilitate the Global Procurement and Supply Chain Policy and related processes, ensuring project teams and stakeholders understand their value and comply with requirements.
* Manage and support requests for proposals (RFPs), including commercial and contractual negotiations, in close collaboration with Legal (GCO), Global Client Serving Partners, Sector Leaders, and other business partners.
* Improve sourcing efficiency and compliance by implementing purchase orders and using AI tools where appropriate.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies that align with business priorities and deliver commercial value and operational efficiency.
* Lead complex sourcing projects from opportunity assessment through contract execution, including competitive events, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and ongoing governance.
* Advise business leaders on procurement and influence decisions through market intelligence, spend analysis, and strategic recommendations.
* Oversee the negotiation and management of MSAs, FSAs, SOWs, amendments, and other commercial contracts.
* Collaborate with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance teams to implement appropriate contractual protections and manage supplier risks effectively.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers, conduct governance reviews, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support supplier onboarding, due diligence, compliance reviews, and remediation activities as needed.
* Engage extensively with stakeholders and partner effectively with senior business leaders across functions and geographies.
* Act as a trusted procurement advisor, providing commercial guidance and serving as an escalation point for strategic supplier and contractual matters.
* Contribute to procurement transformation, process improvement, capability development, and the mentoring of procurement professionals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Business acumen and commercial skills to help leadership drive procurement and demand management strategies across a broad array of portfolios.
* Strong sourcing project delivery with the ability to deliver compliance processes
* Strong negotiator and influencer capable of supporting leadership in driving alignment with key senior stakeholders and leaders.
* Deep knowledge of Talent categories and understanding for Talent categories.
* The ability to drive change by building strong, trusting relationships with senior stakeholders and business partners
* Sound judgment and decision\-making abilities
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage and prioritize workload
* Demonstrate a positive attitude and have an appetite for change and learning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Experience in Talent Procurement in a collaborative, high\-performance environment and preferable experience with the Human Capital Procurement category
* Strong procurement expertise and commercial acumen to drive sourcing and demand management strategies across a broad array of category services.
* Ability to align efforts with key stakeholders and influence these leaders, as necessary, and possess a global mindset
* Experience on execution of online Rfx and e\-Auctions
* Advanced English and able to lead conversations autonomously.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A Bachelor’s and follow\-on degree in Business or similar discipline is recommended.
* CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management) will be a plus
* 10\+ years of experience in Procurement
* Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English
* Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization
* Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a high energy individual who embraces change to ensure we can continue to strategically deliver world\-class quantitative and brand value for the global EY organization in an ever\-changing business environment.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Flexible working arrangements possible: to achieve a lifestyle balance
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Manager – Recruitment
description:
📍 Location: Infopark Phase 2 ,Kochi,Kerala
 



 💼 Experience: 6\-8 years
 



 🏢 Work Model: Work From Office/General Shift
 



  





 The Senior Manager – Recruitment will lead and manage the end\-to\-end talent acquisition function, ensuring achievement of hiring targets within defined timelines, budget guidelines, and quality standards. The role involves driving sourcing strategies, managing recruitment teams, overseeing stakeholder and vendor management, optimizing recruitment processes, and ensuring a strong candidate experience while aligning hiring delivery with business objectives.
 



  





**Duties and responsibilities:** 




  





**Recruitment Strategy \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, workforce plans, and hiring priorities.
* Develop recruitment strategies for volume, niche, and leadership hiring requirements.
* Create sourcing plans aligned to business expansion, attrition trends, and critical skill requirements.
* Drive recruitment process improvements to enhance efficiency, candidate quality, and hiring outcomes.



**Team Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of recruiters and sourcing specialists.
* Allocate requisitions based on recruiter capability, bandwidth, and business priority.
* Monitor team productivity, sourcing effectiveness, and recruitment pipeline health.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability\-building initiatives for the recruitment team.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SLAs, policies, and compliance standards



**Talent Sourcing \& Networking** 



* Oversee sourcing activities across multiple channels including job portals, employee referrals, social media platforms, consultants, and internal databases.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Develop market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, and competitor hiring practices.
* Strengthen employer branding initiatives to improve talent attraction.



**Screening \& Selection** 



* Guide recruiters in candidate assessment and shortlisting processes to ensure hiring quality.
* Ensure structured screening and interview processes are followed across all business units.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to ensure timely interview feedback and decision\-making.
* Monitor selection quality and ensure alignment with competency and cultural fit requirements.



**Stakeholder \& Candidate Management** 



* Build strong working relationships with business leaders and hiring stakeholders.
* Ensure seamless and professional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Handle escalations related to recruitment delivery, offer negotiations, and candidate engagement.



**Recruitment Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure accurate maintenance of recruitment data, reports, and ATS records.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, dashboards, and periodic hiring reports.
* Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies, audit requirements, and documentation standards.
* Support HR audits and management reviews related to talent acquisition processes.



**Recruitment Budget Planning** 



* Prepare and manage the annual recruitment budget in alignment with workforce planning and business hiring projections.
* Monitor recruitment\-related expenses including job portals, consultancy fees, campus hiring, employee referral payouts, travel expenses etc.
* Track budget utilization against approved allocations and ensure cost\-effective hiring practices.
* Coordinate with Finance and Business Heads for recruitment forecasting and manpower budgeting exercises.



**External Vendor Management** 



* Manage external recruitment vendors, job portals, and hiring partners to support recruitment activities
* Coordinate and monitor recruitment processes related to consultants, agencies, and sourcing platforms to ensure effective hiring support.
* Oversee the usage and performance of job portals and external hiring channels to improve sourcing efficiency and recruitment outcomes.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with labour laws and internal HR policies.
* Support employer branding initiatives by promoting company culture and values through job postings and social media platforms.



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




  




* MBA in HR stream or Graduation in any discipline
* 10\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing a recruitment team.
* Experience handling volume hiring, niche hiring, and stakeholder management.
* Exposure to ATS platforms, job portals, market standards and recruitment analytics preferred.

description:

**Senior**
 As part of our EY Cyber security, Technology Consulting team, your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You will be responsible for delivery and maintaining quality of services and deliverables on your engagements. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY and GDS within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Senior Consultant who help our clients improve their security and data protection posture to respond to the dynamic data and security threats. You will provide data privacy and protection domain expertise and utilise your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build, deploy and test pragmatic security solutions that will give real and tangible benefits and security enhancement. * A proven ability to develop and implement data breach response plans and manage privacy incidents effectively.
* Experience in developing privacy strategies and roadmaps.
* Experience in planning and implementation of privacy controls.
* Strong understanding on RoPA documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to craft and maintain comprehensive privacy policies and procedures.
* Proficiency in a variety of data privacy regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, DPDPA etc.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify complex privacy issues and develop practical solutions.
* A passion for data privacy and a commitment to staying current with evolving industry trends and regulations.
* Good Understanding of risk assessment frameworks.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduates / BE \- B. Tech / MCA / M. Sc (Stats, Maths, Computer Science) / MBA with background in computer science and programming.
* Certifications related to Data Privacy such as CIPP, CIPM, CIPT etc.
* Functional and non\-functional privacy requirements definition and documentation experience.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills.
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and Lead Implementer.


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

description:
**Company Description** 
 Giridhar Eye Institute (GEI), located in Kadavanthara, Kochi, is an NABH\-accredited eye hospital offering a broad range of comprehensive eye care services. Established in 1997, GEI has grown into a recognized center of excellence known for its strong commitment to values and ethical medical practice. The institute focuses on delivering personalized, high\-quality care at an affordable cost to patients from diverse backgrounds. Team members at GEI work in a professional, patient\-centric environment that emphasizes integrity, clinical excellence, and continuous improvement. Joining GEI means contributing to a mission\-driven organization dedicated to patient satisfaction and community eye health.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site HR Recruiter role based in Kochi. The HR Recruiter will manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including understanding staffing needs, drafting job descriptions, sourcing candidates, screening resumes, and scheduling and coordinating interviews. The role involves maintaining candidate pipelines, managing communication with applicants, and supporting hiring managers in selection and offer processes. The HR Recruiter will also assist with onboarding new employees, maintaining recruitment records, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and relevant labor regulations. In addition, the role may support employer branding initiatives, campus drives, and HR projects aimed at improving talent acquisition and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in candidate sourcing, resume screening, and interview coordination.
* Ability to manage recruitment cycles, from job posting and shortlisting to offer and onboarding.
* Knowledge of HR best practices, basic labor laws, and ethical hiring standards.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HR databases, and MS Office tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively at all levels.
* Strong organizational, time management, and follow\-up skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in recruitment, preferably in healthcare or hospital settings, is highly desirable.
* Commitment to confidentiality, fairness, and non\-discriminatory hiring practices.

title: People Operations Admin @ Resonate CX
description:
**People Operations Admin** 





 Recruitment  •  People Operations  •  Administration  •  Global Team Support
 




**About Resonate** 





 Resonate is an Australian customer experience (CX) software company. For a decade, we’ve helped organisations listen to their customers and act on what they hear. Today, we work across global markets, supported by a team spanning Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
 





 We’re at an exciting point in our journey — growing, investing in our product, and building the kind of company people are proud to be part of. This is a brand\-new role, created to help us do exactly that.
 




**The Role** 





 As our People Operations Admin, you’ll play an important role in keeping our People Operations running smoothly and helping create a great employee experience across Resonate.
 





 This is a hands\-on role covering recruitment, people administration, onboarding, employee experience, culture initiatives and day\-to\-day People \& Culture support. You’ll work closely with the People \& Culture team, managers and employees across our global locations.
 




**What You’ll Do** 




**Recruitment** 



* Support recruitment activities including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination and candidate communication.



**People Operations \& Administration** 



* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Support day\-to\-day People \& Culture administration, reporting and employee lifecycle processes.
* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, including introductions, systems access and resources.



**People \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Support employee engagement, recognition, surveys, culture initiatives and internal People \& Culture communications.
* Help coordinate company events, team activities and employee programs.



**Global Team Support** 



* Support employees across Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
* Coordinate activities across locations and time zones and work with local providers and partners.
* Help create connection, consistency and a positive employee experience across our distributed teams.



  





**About You** 





 You’re organised, approachable and genuinely enjoy helping people. You don’t need to know everything about HR — what matters most is that you’re curious, proactive and eager to learn.
 



* 1–3 years’ experience in HR, People \& Culture, People Operations, administration, recruitment or a similar role.
* Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive approach, good problem\-solving skills and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office/365\.
* Ability to work confidently with AI tools and an interest in smarter ways of working.
* Basic graphic design skills.
* Event planning or coordination experience is a nice\-to\-have.
* Experience working with distributed or global teams is an advantage.



**What We Offer** 



* Broad exposure to People \& Culture and the opportunity to build your HR career.
* Real ownership and the opportunity to make an impact from day one.
* Exposure to leaders and teams across a growing global business.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative team environment.
* The opportunity to grow with Resonate as the business continues to evolve.
* Opportunities to travel and experience different parts of the world.



**Why Resonate?** 





 At Resonate, we believe great customer experiences start with great employee experiences. We’re a growing, global team that values collaboration, curiosity, ownership and having a bit of fun along the way.
 





 If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, contribute and make a real difference to the employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.
 




**How to Apply** 





 If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and tell us a little about yourself and why you’d be a great addition to the Resonate team.
